FINITE OPTICAL CORRELATION TEST: CONDITIONAL CONSTRUCTION
1 November 2026. Solo derivation; no independent audit of this new composition.
Natural logarithms. Trace norm means ||.||_1; probability changes are bounded
by half that norm. The theorem below is conditional on the stated physical
channels and He's all-block classical contraction, not on a finite simulation.

1. Task and source contract

Prepare K independent two-mode squeezed purifications of thermal tau_n on A,
with actual purifier C. A passes through a thermal attenuator of transmission
eta and added output occupation b>0, giving B of mean s=eta*n+b. A source
encoder acts on C before access to B. Under H0 the encoded memory and B are
matched. Under H1 they have the SAME marginals but are independent. Retained
input-correlated flags, side registers and random seeds count as memory.

The source-information charge is I(A^K:M), before the A-to-B relevance channel.
For each C, first apply vacuum loss lambda, then the physical write below.
Data processing gives actual cost <=
 R = g(n)+g(lambda*n)-g((1-lambda)*n),
 g(x)=(1+x)log(1+x)-x log x.
Before receiver processing the product memory has K qubits, dimension 2^K.
Fresh source-independent measurement ancillas are allowed to both contestants.
B is common observation access outside this predictive-memory cap. Temporary
raw optical storage and actual apparatus are not made free by that convention.

He, predictive compression, Prop. 5 and Appendix R, using Lemma 12, supplies
for EVERY normal classical block encoder at total source cost <=K R:
 alpha_C<=epsilon =>
 log beta_C >= -(K*c_n*R+log 2)/(1-epsilon),
 c_n=eta*log(1+1/(eta*n+b))/log(1+1/n).
This even allows an unlimited classical alphabet and any joint B readout.
Its tensor statement is essential; a single-copy Gaussian optimum would not
prove it. No independent review of that external tensor proof is claimed here.

2. Actual finite-dimensional write, storage and read

An initially ground qubit interacts through
 U_w=exp[-i theta_w (a sigma_+ + a^dag sigma_-)];
discard the OLD optical C port and compensate its known swap phase. On the
full optical |0>,|1> operator algebra this is exactly amplitude damping with
transmission eta_w=sin^2(theta_w). No projection onto that head is performed.
All higher-photon inputs undergo the same physical unitary and discarding.

GOVERNING SOURCES, ACTUAL TRANSFERS AND INCUMBENTS
1 November 2026. Sources are evidence at their stated scope, not device access.

External first: the three supplied Zixuan He / University of Glasgow preprints

1. Optimal quantum channel certification with coherent light, v1.1, 28 Oct 2026.
   https://zenodo.org/records/23746737
   Latest-version API returned this same record today. The PDF filename ends
   v10 although the record version is 1.1. Cached 37-page PDF identity:
   SHA256 2de704db53e75e9e4b4f93a6cf295a9e42a1c280c923ec3a07495ced667a3cd6.
   Main statement and Appendices A-C were read for the upper mechanism.
   One selected formula page was rendered and visually checked.

   Scope: a normal memoryless bosonic channel, identity versus an alternative
   separated in energy-constrained diamond norm, conditional coherent probes,
   expected physical illumination charged under every promised channel, and
   trusted coherent preparation/displaced vacuum tests. It is not general
   verification of an arbitrary noisy transducer or a memoryful device.
   The mechanism controls the Stinespring finite head using coherent overlaps,
   anti-holomorphic derivative estimates and Gaussian Green/Hermite weights;
   the dyadic probe distribution pays rare bright illumination explicitly.
   Our phase-flip control confirms the importance of that acquisition resource:
   at Fock level 128, mean-one Gaussian probes detect at about 5.88e-39 per
   call, versus .0010624 for brightness 128 used with probability 1/128.
   This family control is not a new optimal minimax rate.

2. Quantum limits and one-qubit advantage in optical predictive compression,
   v1.0, 25 Oct 2026. https://zenodo.org/records/23650027
   Latest-version API returned this record today. Cached 61-page PDF:
   SHA256 075456b81bb08fcbcb2621e827303f838a96a43e7a0747da98661f68c806c872.
   Decisive passages read: main source/encoder/classical frontier and Prop. 5
   (PDF pp. 1-8), the full relevant finite-qubit Appendix Q and testing Appendix
   R (pp. 56-58), tensor contraction Lemma 12/proof (pp. 33-36), and its
   four-weight interpolation dependency (Theorem 10, pp. 27-32).

   This supplies the thermal purified source, actual source-information cost,
   full optical-tail accounting and all-classical block converse. Prop. 5 itself
   uses an asymptotic quantum Stein test without a finite detector circ
